cards.name: One Ring to Rule Them All

name: Tom's Bombs
notes: Ways to win: infinite combos, Helix Pinnacle, All Will Be One, Maze's End (20 different Gates), and Saga value.
Infinite mana: Freed from the Real or Pemmin's Aura on Bloom Tender, Faeburrow Elder, Sage of the Maze, or Sanctum Weaver (with 2+ enchantments). That's 8 combinations.
Sage of the Maze also doubles your Gate mana without a combo: tap a Gate to untap Sage, and Sage taps for 2.

Spending infinite mana: Clockspinning with buyback. Next to All Will Be One, each added counter deals damage. Or re-trigger a Saga's final chapter (such as Summon: Bahamut) while it's still on the stack.

Sagas confirmed: 13 enchantment Sagas plus 4 Final Fantasy Summon Saga creatures = 17. City of Death and Explore the Underdark are unconfirmed. Terra flips into a Saga, but Tom's reveal won't find it.
Game Changers (3): Demonic Tutor, The One Ring, Crop Rotation. That's the Bracket 3 limit.

Oct 12 land review: keep Maze's End, Command Tower, Plaza of Harmony, Nesting Grounds, Underground Sea, The World Tree and the 7 basics. Other land upgrades: Reflecting Pool, Mana Confluence or City of Brass.

Oct 13: Added Destiny Spinner, Helix Pinnacle, All Will Be One and Urza's Saga. Cut Kefka, Court Mage, Rakdos Guildgate, The Grey Havens and Exotic Orchard. Still 3 Game Changers. Considered Calix, Guided by Fate and passed: its token-copy ability needs combat damage.

Nov 13, 2026: Tom (sleeve-today list with the Saga swaps) vs Lawyers (Kynaios and Tiro): kill-turn race on a B3 table, Tom first 79%, Lawyers first 10%, neither by turn 16 12%. With Lawyer counters, wipes and enchantment removal doubled: Tom 47%, Lawyers 13%, neither 40%. By turn 12: Tom 47% (B3) / 25% (B4) vs Lawyers 9% / 5%. Tom's risk is the stack, wipes and Rule of Law, not the clock. Compare with Doom's Big Wheels: 72% / 51% by turn 12, Doom Unrivaled: 66% by turn 8 (different sims, not calibrated against each other).

Nov 23, 2026: Cut Summon: Knights of Round (8 mana, slow 5-chapter Saga) for Fireball, a table-wide infinite-mana outlet (extra targets cost {1} each). Walking Ballista still incoming; planned slot: Historian's Boon. Drain Life considered and passed (one target, black-only X).

notes: Nov 12, 2026 merge of the Oct 13 main list, the B3+ combo variant and the Nov 12 rebuild. Main list and the B3+ combo variant are untouched; this is a separate version.

Starts from the Nov 12 rebuild: adds Cruelty of Gix, The Eldest Reborn, Sigurd, Flux Channeler, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Azusa's Many Journeys, Summon: Yojimbo, The Black Gate, Fellwar Stone, Timeless Lotus, Circuitous Route, Dance of the Manse, Hour of Promise, Perplex, Walking Ballista. Then takes 7 swaps from the vault versions (see adds).
Game Changers (3): Demonic Tutor, The One Ring, Crop Rotation. The added tutors are not Game Changers.

Bracket honesty: Pemmin's Aura or Freed from the Real on Bloom Tender, Faeburrow Elder, Sage of the Maze or Sanctum Weaver is a cheap, early two-card infinite. Plays as Bracket 4 in practice; tell the table, or agree no infinite before turn 6. Not simulated; the B3+ combo variant has the only sim numbers (49.1% win by turn 12 on a B3 table).
One Ring to Rule Them All chapter II destroys your own nonlegendary creatures, mana creatures included. Legendary survivors: Tom, Satsuki, Sigurd, Goldberry, Terra, Xavier Sal, Narci, O'aka.
Unverified texts: Walking Ballista, Sterling Grove, Plea for Guidance, Idyllic Tutor, Eladamri's Call (from memory); several Gates not yet read.

notes: Nov 12, 2026: built from B3+ combo v2 with the 16 unchecked cards (Ballista excluded, incoming) replaced by cards you have.
Sim (3,000 games): win by turn 12 on a B3 table 45.1% vs 53.4% for V2 with every card and 47.0% for B3+ combo as vaulted; B4 table 24.7% vs 30.3% and 25.1%.

Buy order (gain in turns by sim, approx. LP/NM price): Plea for Guidance +0.29 ($0.75), Dimir Machinations +0.15 ($1), Staff of Domination +0.13 ($4), Idyllic Tutor +0.18 ($8), Diabolic Intent +0.21 ($12). Optional: Eladamri's Call, Umbral Mantle, Finale of Devastation, Green Sun's Zenith, The Horus Heresy.

Skip for now: Grim Tutor (~$56), Argothian Enchantress (~$49), Mana Confluence (~$45), Urza's Saga (~$42), Birds of Paradise, Utopia Sprawl. Gains are small and several overlap the same Mind Stone slot, so they will not stack fully.
Your 3-cost any-color rocks are fine as stand-ins for Signets, Talismans or Mind Stone (no measurable difference). Keep Fellwar Stone, Hour of Promise and the basic Swamp slots.
Nov 12, 2026: Goldberry, River-Daughter swapped in for Mind Stone (sim: neutral here, small plus in full V2; she costs {1}{U}). Mind Stone was the weakest stand-in.

Nov 12, 2026: Summon: Brynhildr in for Satyr Enchanter and Summon: G.F. Ifrit in for Talisman of Dominance (sim: about +0.13 turns on a B3 table, +0.11 on B4). Summon: Anima (~$0.23) was the best other Summon (+0.14 alone) if you want to buy it.

Nov 13, 2026: Saga swaps from the all-Sagas sim (Sagas, Summon Sagas and Saga creatures; 3,000 paired games): Creation of Avacyn for Three Blind Mice, Esper Origins for Terra, The Bath Song for Selesnya Signet, Showdown of the Skalds for Simic Signet. About +0.37 turns faster on a B3 table and +0.21 on B4 vs the previous sleeve-today list. Until Creation and Origins arrive, Bath Song and Showdown alone are about +0.3 (B3).

Tested and skipped: Song of Eärendil (nothing added on top of this package; Fellwar Stone is better kept), Summon Sagas beyond Brynhildr and Ifrit, and the other Saga creatures (Huatli, Joshua, Jill, Dion, Clive, Vorinclex and the Praetors: flip costs too high, about zero). The sim could not model Jecht's flip.
